fieldValues.title: RFC-005 gets an rfc record and its stale key field is fixed
fieldValues.summary: RFC-005's normative changes were fully folded into the canonical spec years ago (relation-type.json, package-manifest.json, package-bundle.json, the Core/Extension conformance requirements mechanisms, and I-88 all cite it by name) but it carried no com.semanticops.spec/rfc stub record, so it was invisible to check-rfc-integration.mjs. Created the stub record with a full srs-integration:v1 manifest, transitioned it draft -> proposed -> accepted, fixed the seven relationType-keyed example JSON blocks in the RFC's own .md (RFC-006 renamed the field to key before RFC-005's definitions were ever installed; the shipped files always used key), and added the required Charter alignment section.
fieldValues.body: PR https://github.com/the-greenman/srs/pull/773 (gate:owner-merge — the Draft->Accepted status flip is the owner's act). Both gates green by exit code: validate-all.mjs and check-release-drift.mjs (the latter was red before re-rendering docs/spec/rfcs/rfc-catalog.md with the pinned CLI to pick up the new record). Proved the new check surface by stripping the manifest, confirming check-rfc-integration.mjs went red with the expected three diagnostics, then restoring it and confirming green.
